purpose: Historically attested pre-ancient motif vocabulary for controlled item-generation accents. This is a research index, not permission to copy sacred marks or decorate every item.

automation_policy.restricted_entries: research-only unless Alex explicitly approves a specific use

motifs.label: plain hammered field
motifs.prompt: one broad undecorated hammered field with visible hand-planishing

motifs.label: single raised rim
motifs.prompt: one plain raised structural rim, without rays or concentric ornament

motifs.label: paired edge ribs
motifs.prompt: two narrow parallel strengthening ribs confined to an edge

motifs.label: single blade midrib
motifs.prompt: one functional raised midrib with plain flanking blade fields

motifs.label: stepped blade shoulders
motifs.prompt: plain stepped shoulders and rivet logic, no emblem

motifs.label: single punched-dot row
motifs.prompt: one short bounded row of irregular hand-punched dots

motifs.label: double punched-dot row
motifs.prompt: one narrow double row of hand-punched dots along an edge

motifs.label: opposed triangle border
motifs.prompt: one narrow band of opposed incised triangles, non-radial

motifs.label: hatched triangle border
motifs.prompt: one short band of uneven hand-incised hatched triangles

motifs.label: alternating triangle border
motifs.prompt: one bounded strip of alternating plain and hatched triangles

motifs.label: single chevron band
motifs.prompt: one narrow hand-made chevron band with irregular spacing

motifs.label: nested chevron band
motifs.prompt: one short nested-chevron edge panel, never a central emblem

motifs.label: broken zigzag band
motifs.prompt: one discontinuous zigzag border made by hand

motifs.label: sawtooth edge
motifs.prompt: one restrained sawtooth edge treatment, not rays

motifs.label: lozenge chain
motifs.prompt: one narrow chain of elongated lozenges along a hem or rim

motifs.label: crosshatched lozenge
motifs.prompt: one bounded crosshatched lozenge panel, off-center and non-radial

motifs.label: checker strip
motifs.prompt: one narrow two-color checker strip woven into an edge

motifs.label: ladder border
motifs.prompt: one simple ladder-like border confined to a seam

motifs.label: herringbone incisions
motifs.prompt: one narrow herringbone-incised band

motifs.label: herringbone weave
motifs.prompt: a small bounded herringbone weave field, not applied metal ornament

motifs.label: diagonal basket twill
motifs.prompt: visible diagonal basketry structure created by the material itself

motifs.label: coiled basket courses
motifs.prompt: plain coiled basketry courses with no painted emblem

motifs.label: reed-bundle stripes
motifs.prompt: parallel reed-bundle stripes created by binding structure

motifs.label: plain woven color bands
motifs.prompt: two or three plain woven color bands with no emblem or medallion

motifs.label: bounded cross-stitch seam
motifs.prompt: one functional cross-laced seam forming a simple repeated X structure

motifs.label: vertical ribs
motifs.prompt: several functional vertical ribs with large plain spaces between them

motifs.label: short hand-cut fluting
motifs.prompt: a few broad hand-cut flutes confined to the grip or socket

motifs.label: beaded metal edge
motifs.prompt: one restrained beaded edge made of uneven raised pellets

motifs.label: corded relief edge
motifs.prompt: one cast cord-like edge border, not loose rope or dangling cord

motifs.label: scalloped plate edge
motifs.prompt: a restrained sequence of broad scallops along one plate edge

motifs.label: imbricated scale layout
motifs.prompt: overlapping scales themselves form a plain imbricated pattern

motifs.label: single palmette
motifs.prompt: one simplified palmette confined to a small terminal field, no surrounding rays

motifs.label: split-palmette border fragment
motifs.prompt: one short split-palmette edge fragment with most of the surface plain

motifs.label: lotus-petal row
motifs.prompt: one short row of upright lotus petals along a rim, never a circular flower

motifs.label: papyrus-fan border
motifs.prompt: one narrow border of simplified papyrus fans, not a sacred centerpiece

motifs.label: leaf-and-bud chain
motifs.prompt: one short alternating leaf-and-bud edge chain

motifs.label: date-palm sprig
motifs.prompt: one small stylized date-palm sprig in a bounded rectangular field

motifs.label: single ibex profile
motifs.prompt: one small simplified ibex profile on a terminal plate, no procession

motifs.label: single horse profile
motifs.prompt: one compact horse profile confined to tack or a terminal plate

motifs.label: single waterbird profile
motifs.prompt: one small angular waterbird silhouette on an edge field

motifs.label: single fish profile
motifs.prompt: one small linear fish profile in a narrow rectangular field

motifs.label: rosette
motifs.prompt: research only; often divine and easily becomes a sun symbol

motifs.label: rayed sun disk
motifs.prompt: never auto-use

motifs.label: winged disk
motifs.prompt: never auto-use

motifs.label: crescent emblem
motifs.prompt: research only; no ordinary item use

motifs.label: lightning-fork emblem
motifs.prompt: research only; no ordinary item use

motifs.label: sacred tree
motifs.prompt: research only; never copy as generic decoration

motifs.label: horns of consecration
motifs.prompt: research only; culture-specific sacred form

motifs.label: double axe or labrys
motifs.prompt: research only; do not use as generic badge

motifs.label: eight-spoked wheel
motifs.prompt: never auto-use; repeatedly collapses into a solar emblem

motifs.label: concentric sunburst
motifs.prompt: never auto-use

motifs.label: human-face centerpiece
motifs.prompt: never auto-use on ordinary inventory items
